fullDescription: EduStream Premium Dark is a high-end, luxury-themed educational interface designed for elite learning platforms, fintech, or executive SaaS dashboards. It features a deep navy (#0a0e14) and charcoal aesthetic accented by a sophisticated premium gold (#d4af37). The design leverages glassmorphism with subtle blurs, high-contrast serif typography for headings (BespokeSerif), and meticulous spacing to create an editorial, professional feel. Key features include mesh gradients, shimmer animations, and smooth cubic-bezier transitions that evoke a sense of exclusivity and academic excellence.

structured.summary: A sleek, professional dark-mode dashboard with gold accents, utilizing glassmorphism and editorial typography to create a premium, high-status atmosphere for educational or corporate environments.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Dark Luxury' theme. It pairs the modern 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for utility with the elegant 'BespokeSerif' for high-impact headings. Colors are strictly controlled: deep navy (#0a0e14) for backgrounds, white for primary text, and a multi-stop gold gradient (#d4af37 to #f9d976) for primary actions and highlights. Components use a translucent 'glass' background (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) with fine borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) and high-performance animations (cubic-bezier transitions).
style.prompt: Create a premium dark UI using a deep navy background (#0a0e14). Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text and 'BespokeSerif' for headers. Primary accent color is Gold (#d4af37); use it as a text color and in a linear gradient (135deg, #d4af37 0%, #f9d976 50%, #d4af37 100%). Implement glassmorphism cards with 'background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'. Apply a 'stagger-in' animation to all major sections using 'opacity: 0; transform: translateY(15px); animation: reveal 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards'. Interactive elements should have a hover lift of -5px and a soft gold glow 'box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.05)'.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a centered 1280px (max-w-7xl) grid with generous padding and vertical spacing. It begins with a sticky navigation bar, followed by a large hero card, a 4-column metrics grid, a 3-column content grid, and a split 8:4 main content area for community and milestones.

prompts.prompt: A fixed h-20 navigation bar with 'backdrop-filter: blur(20px)' and a bottom border 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'. Left side contains a logo with a rounded-lg gold icon and BespokeSerif brand text. Center contains uppercase nav links with 0.15em tracking and a 13px font size. Right side features a rounded-full search input (white/5 bg) and a profile section with a 36px circular avatar and status badge.

A large rounded-[3rem] glassmorphism card containing a radial mesh gradient (gold and indigo at low opacities). Left side: A gold tag with 0.2em tracking, a 5xl BespokeSerif heading, and two pill-shaped buttons (one gold gradient, one outlined). Right side: A nested glass card showing course progress with a gold shimmer progress bar and percentage text.
A 4-column grid of smaller glass cards. Each card features a 48x48px rounded-2xl icon container (white/5 bg), gold icon, uppercase tertiary label (slate-500), and a large 24px bold numeric value.

A 3-column layout of vertical glass cards with rounded-[2.5rem]. Top half: Image container with 60% opacity and a dark gradient overlay. Hovering the card increases image scale to 105% and opacity to 100%. Bottom half: 40px padding, gold category label, large bold title, and a thin white progress bar at the bottom.

An 8-column vs 4-column layout. The left 8-columns contain discussion cards with large 48px profile avatars and gold-tinted hover titles. The right 4-columns feature a standout 'Milestone' card with a solid gold-gradient background, navy text (#0a0e14), and a high-contrast dark button for primary CTA.

special_ui_components.description: Animated progress bar with a glowing gold fill.
special_ui_components.prompt: The track is 'bg-white/5' with 'rounded-full' height of 6px. The fill uses 'linear-gradient(135deg, #d4af37, #f9d976)' and a box-shadow '0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4)'. Implement as a width animation using 'transition: width 2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)' triggered on mount.

Inside the hero container, apply 'background: radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15) 0%, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 20% 80%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1) 0%, transparent 40%)'. This creates a soft, ambient glow behind the text without sacrificing readability.

special_ui_components.description: Gold gradient button with an infinite shimmer effect.
special_ui_components.prompt: A pill-shaped button with 'background: #d4af37'. Add a pseudo-element '::after' with a linear-gradient (transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent) skewed at -25deg. Animate the pseudo-element from left: -100% to left: 200% over 4s to create a luxury shimmer light-sweep effect.
